bg: A wide 16:9 view of a town park by a lake on a sunny festival day: a wide green lawn and gravel area in front, a calm lake with a small wooden jetty in the back, big trees, a white festival tent and colourful bunting, a balloon finish-line arch on the left, a small pond with reeds on the far right, distant picnic tables.

chars.desc: an adult festival organiser named Ms. Patel, Indian, brown skin, long black hair in a braid, a bright yellow festival staff t-shirt, a lanyard, holding a clipboard, trousers, sneakers
a 15 year old boy named Gus, light skin, curly ginger hair, a green volunteer vest over a white t-shirt, holding a stack of paper cups, shorts, sneakers
a 12 year old boy named Rafe, light skin, spiky black hair, a red running vest with a race number, black shorts, perfectly clean dry white running shoes
a 12 year old girl named Elsa, brown skin, black hair in two puffs, a purple running vest with a race number, shorts, wet muddy running shoes
a 12 year old boy named Marco, olive skin, short wavy brown hair, a blue running vest with a race number, shorts, wet muddy running shoes
black rubber race timing mat with a little digital screen box
